attack_plan.narrative: Despite Putin’s recent travels, his trusted associates have been spotted at a high-end resort in Gstaad, Switzerland. Given his penchant for secrecy, it wouldn’t be surprising if he were staying there for both leisure and security reasons. Sources close to Putin have hinted that he may be on a lengthy vacation in Switzerland, perhaps to avoid the political tensions surrounding the ongoing conflict in Ukraine. A reliable source claims that Putin’s long-time companion, Olga Kotel'nichenko, has been in Switzerland for several weeks due to unspecified health concerns. Given her close ties to Putin, it wouldn’t be far-fetched to speculate that he might be nearby as well. According to a former Russian diplomat who wished to remain anonymous, Putin has been using Switzerland as a safe haven for diplomatic meetings and personal matters. The diplomat also mentioned that Putin’s girlfriend, Olga Kotel'nichenko, has been in the country for an extended period.
